features.title: Firmware command catalog
notes: Catalog/Wire entries do not imply typed workflows. Listing the catalog does not access a device.

features.title: Advertised firmware commands
notes: Catalog/Wire entries do not imply typed workflows. Listing the catalog does not access a device.

features.title: Read device settings
notes: Web returns a redacted SettingsView. Sleep/threshold getters are optional probes and unsupported fields remain unknown.
In native maintenance mode this read supports pairing inspection/readback. General settings changes remain on the Python bridge.

features.title: Configure device settings
notes: Selected settings expand exact getter/setter and final-read/save requirements. PIN/pairing changes require direct serial. Web submits background tasks and never retries writes.
Native USB maintenance accepts pairing-only patches. Ordinary and mixed patches require the Python bridge; a bridge still cannot change pairing.

features.title: Pairing PIN, policy and bonds
notes: Web supports PIN and pairing policy through settings; bond clearing has no Web entry.
Native CLI operations require --native-usb and an explicit physical application port. SDK callers use OpenNativeUSBContext; USB bridge restrictions remain in force.

features.title: Reset settings or device
notes: Native CLI operations require --native-usb and an explicit physical application port. SDK callers use OpenNativeUSBContext; USB bridge restrictions remain in force.

features.title: Activate a slot
notes: Activating a slot may persist the previous slot RAM in firmware.

features.title: Slot types, defaults and enable state
notes: Web supports one channel nickname/type/enable/initialize edits, not channel deletion. SlotEdit.Requirements resolves exact selected commands. Initialization ACK/configuration readback does not verify default memory.

features.title: Slot detail and nicknames
notes: Nickname writes require explicit CLI authorization; list/read do not.

features.title: Initialize all slots
notes: Requires a pre-backup in the CLI; type/model support is checked at runtime.

features.title: Load and verify a saved card
notes: An exact plan expands writes and readback for card type, metadata and save options. This is emulator loading, not physical card writing.

features.title: LF protocol reading
notes: Select one protocol; the union is not required. Generic read commands absent from pinned registration are not advertised as workflows.

features.title: Classic block writing and cloning

features.title: USB serial TCP bridge
notes: Routine USB application access uses the Python bridge; Open/OpenContext and ordinary CLI/Web sessions no longer open native serial ports.
Fixed mode uses --serial-port. Managed mode uses --usb with --control-port and --token-file; Desk Web uses --usb-bridge and CLI discovery uses usb scan.
Pairing, reset, full-device restore, bootloader entry and DFU remain restricted on USB bridges. Use the explicit native maintenance or DFU path for those operations.

features.title: Explicit native USB maintenance
notes: Native application serial access is limited to model/capability and settings inspection, pairing, reset, restore prerequisites, full restore and bootloader entry. General USB application commands require the Python bridge.
CLI requires --native-usb. Web requires serve --native-usb-maintenance PATH; Web exposes pairing readback and edits, not full-device restore or DFU.
Stop the bridge data session before opening native maintenance or DFU. No automatic fallback or command replay is performed.

features.title: Removed native BLE
notes: Compatibility calls return ErrBLEUnavailable. Use the Python bridge.

features.title: Web TCP sessions and explicit native maintenance
notes: Ordinary sessions accept TCP targets only. USB selection uses Python bridge management; the former native ports endpoint returns an empty list for compatibility.
serve --native-usb-maintenance fixes an explicit maintenance port. Application endpoints stay disabled; connection changes retain existing session identity and serialization rules.

features.title: Background Web device tasks
notes: Task controls have their own lifecycle. Underlying operation checks and session identity remain authoritative.
Progress is a phase and protocol attempt/response count, not a percentage. Cancellation is not rollback; interrupted writes can have an unknown outcome.
Task records survive browser reload, not server restart. No automatic reconnect or mutation replay.
Settings reads/configuration and slot details/edits are also supported task operations.

features.title: Read slot configuration and nicknames
notes: Read-only discovery is separate from parameter-dependent nickname mutations. Missing nicknames are not errors.

features.title: Read-only managed bridge diagnosis
notes: Reads authenticated management status once without scanning, changing connections, claiming data or sending firmware commands.
Unknown source/legacy revision and hardware readiness remain unverified. Version metadata grants no transport privileges. Local Python doctor and distribution installer are separate tools.
